Checked po_5001 rev 1: payout PO-5001 of 216000 GBP initiated 2026-11-02T08:30:00Z covering ord_1001, ord_1002, ord_1003, ord_1004, rfd_2001, fee_3001.
Checked stl_88001 rev 1 (from lookup 0): settlement for PO-5001 has status pending observed at 2026-11-03T12:00:00Z with settled_at null.
Because PO-5001 was still pending two hours after txn_9001 booked at 2026-11-03T10:00:00Z, stl_88001 contradicts the claim that PO-5001 explains txn_9001.
data.rationale: Although payout PO-5001 matches the 216000 GBP amount of bank credit txn_9001, the settlement record stl_88001 shows the transfer to the bank was still pending at 2026-11-03T12:00:00Z, two hours after txn_9001 was booked at 2026-11-03T10:00:00Z. Therefore, the claim that txn_9001 is payout PO-5001 is contradicted.
